messages.subject: Re: runExample("01_hello") An error has occurred
parts:
Hi,

This looks to be an issue where the version of Rcpp on your system is older than the version running on CRAN. In this case upgrading the Rcpp package on your system (via install.packages("Rcpp")) should solve the issue. Let us know if you're still seeing this error after upgrading.

Thanks,
Ian
